meta.description: Analyze codon usage and calculate CAI (Codon Adaptation Index) and RSCU with Biopython, and produce table-aware naive max-CAI codon-optimized sequences. Use when scoring a gene's codon bias against a host, optimizing a CDS for heterologous expression, or studying synonymous codon selection.

scientific_integrity.detail: No output fabricated sequences, reference provenance, measurements, or expression outcomes; all numerical observations trace to exact candidate execution, the public thrA fixture, Biopython 1.85, or codonW 1.4.4.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill stays within sequence analysis and construct-design support, explicitly refuses to equate CAI with expression, and requires additional biological screening before synthesis.

methodological_ground.detail: The selected genetic code is enforced end to end, all routed analyses share an explicit CDS validation contract, CAI interpretation remains host-reference-relative, and the removed nonstandard Nc quantity is not exposed as a candidate capability.

code_usability.detail: All three entrypoints ran twice with empty stderr and byte-identical output, 12 focused tests passed twice, and 57 of 57 independent final checks passed without a candidate mutation.

functional_suitability.note: The promised counts, frequencies, RSCU, GC123, guarded host-relative CAI, and table-aware max-CAI draft routes are complete and executable; Nc and tAI boundaries are explicit.

reliability.note: A shared table-aware validator, actionable typed errors, exact discard reports, table-consistency checks, and deterministic reruns cover the major failure modes.

performance_context.note: The concise entrypoint routes version details, methods, optimization constraints, and provenance into focused references without unnecessary loading.

agent_usability.note: Task routing, validation order, output context, stop conditions, and scientific interpretation are clear; the examples remain adaptable scripts rather than a single structured multi-command CLI.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and actionable troubleshooting are strong, though users adapt built-in examples instead of supplying every input through command-line arguments.

security.note: No credentials, sensitive-data retention, destructive operations, raw-code execution, or unvalidated sequence path was found in the runnable candidate.

maintainability.note: Shared helpers separate validation and CAI behavior from the demonstrations, provenance is exact, and 12 focused regressions pin the repaired boundaries.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, progressive disclosure, composability, idempotency, and escape hatches are strong; result presentation is intentionally human-readable rather than a common machine-output schema.

inputs.label: Deterministic standard-code shipped surfaces
inputs.note: All three entrypoints exited zero twice with empty stderr and byte-identical output; 12 focused tests passed twice; standard optimization reached CAI 1.000 and preserved MAALDDKG*.

assertions.text: All three supplied scripts execute successfully on both invocations.
assertions.note: Each of six script invocations exited zero with empty stderr.

assertions.text: Repeated script invocations produce byte-identical stdout and stderr.
assertions.note: SHA-256 values matched independently for every script pair.

assertions.text: The focused candidate regression suite passes twice with the same cases and outcomes.
assertions.note: Twelve tests passed on both invocations; only elapsed-time text required normalization.

assertions.text: Standard-code optimization reaches the documented maximum and preserves the protein.
assertions.note: The output reports optimized CAI 1.000 and protein MAALDDKG*.

assertions.text: The canonical workflow does not infer expression success from CAI alone.
assertions.note: The skill labels the result a naive max-CAI draft and requires downstream screening.

inputs.label: Vertebrate-mitochondrial table-2 optimization
inputs.note: Every TGA/TGG x AGA/AGG query validated and optimized under table 2 while preserving MW*; an index/table mismatch was rejected.

assertions.text: TGA and TGG are accepted as table-2 tryptophan codons in all tested combinations.
assertions.note: All four source validation results retained the selected sense codon.

assertions.text: AGA and AGG are accepted as table-2 terminal stops in all tested combinations.
assertions.note: Every optimized validation result ended in AGA or AGG.

assertions.text: Every table-2 optimization preserves the source protein.
assertions.note: All four source and optimized sequences translated to MW*.

assertions.text: A CAI index built for another genetic code is rejected before scoring.
assertions.note: The table mismatch raised an explicit not-constructed-with-table-2 error.

assertions.text: The documented route avoids Biopython's unsafe nonstandard DNA optimization path.
assertions.note: The wrapper translates with table 2 and calls the protein optimization path before revalidation.

inputs.label: Strict and permissive CDS validation
inputs.note: Strict mode rejected six malformed boundaries with actionable messages; permissive mode retained ATGGCTTAA and reported NNN at offset 3 and AA at offset 12 exactly.

assertions.text: Strict validation rejects empty, partial, shifted, ambiguous, internal-stop, and whitespace inputs.
assertions.note: All six cases raised CDSValidationError with input-specific text.

assertions.text: Permissive validation discards only whole invalid codons and a trailing partial while retaining frame.
assertions.note: The exact retained sequence was ATGGCTTAA.

assertions.text: Permissive validation reports every discarded segment with exact offsets and reasons.
assertions.note: NNN at offset 3 and AA at offset 12 matched the declared contract.

assertions.text: Counts, frequencies, and RSCU operate from the identical validation result.
assertions.note: All three returned validation objects equal the direct permissive result.

assertions.text: The admitted sequence produces coherent counts, normalized frequencies, and synonymous-family RSCU.
assertions.note: Counts were one each for ATG/GCT/TAA, frequencies summed to one, and alanine RSCU summed to four.

inputs.label: Biopython 1.85 CAI semantics and guards
inputs.note: Live 1.85 execution reproduced indexed-stop contribution, GCC weight 0.05, silent non-strict tie selection, strict tie rejection, guarded excluded-only input, and standard protein preservation.

assertions.text: A stop codon present in the CAI mapping contributes to the live score.
assertions.note: The score with TAG was lower than the otherwise identical score without it.

assertions.text: An unobserved GCC pseudocount normalizes to weight 0.05 against ten observed GCT codons.
assertions.note: The exact live weight was 0.05.

assertions.text: Biopython 1.85 strict false is silent while strict true rejects an equal preferred-codon tie.
assertions.note: The warning list was empty and strict true raised ValueError.

assertions.text: The guarded scorer intercepts an ATG/TGG-only zero denominator and reports exclusions.
assertions.note: CAIScoringError names both excluded codons at indices 0 and 1.

assertions.text: The standard-code wrapper preserves the query protein.
assertions.note: Source and optimized sequences translated to MAALDDKG*.

inputs.label: Public thrA and external Nc boundary
inputs.note: Public table-11 thrA validated and all analyses ran from one state; fresh codonW controls reproduced 30.77 and 47.41; the candidate's false Nc helper and trigger claim are absent.

assertions.text: The public thrA fixture validates under table 11 with its expected length and boundaries.
assertions.note: It contained 2,463 nt / 821 codons, began ATG, ended TGA, and had no discards.

assertions.text: Counts, frequencies, RSCU, and GC123 run from the exact public validation state.
assertions.note: The validation objects matched, 821 codons were counted, frequencies summed to one, and all GC percentages were finite.

assertions.text: Fresh codonW controls reproduce the retained external Nc values.
assertions.note: codonW 1.4.4 returned 30.77 for the heterogeneous fixture and 47.41 for public thrA.

assertions.text: The candidate does not ship or advertise the removed approximation as standard Nc.
assertions.note: No effective_nc implementation or top-level Nc capability claim is present.

assertions.text: The cross-study and external-tool boundary is explicit.
assertions.note: The candidate requires a separately validated Wright/codonW-compatible estimator, exact version reporting, and prohibits comparison of the removed quantity.

key_strengths: All runnable surfaces passed independent execution, including deterministic reruns of every shipped entrypoint and the focused 12-test suite.
The protein-intermediate optimizer respects the selected genetic code end to end and passed all four table-2 sense/stop combinations.
One shared validator gives strict scientific rejection or exact permissive discard provenance to counts, frequencies, RSCU, and CAI routes.
Version-specific Biopython 1.85 behavior is pinned by executable tests instead of relying on generalized API prose.
The former nonstandard Nc approximation is removed, while a reproducible external comparator and honest cross-study boundary remain documented.
